runtime.name: codex-cli
runtime.configuration: Final hardened fixture plus generated poteto-mode/interrogate Skills and reviewer/synthesizer TOML files committed in a disposable Git fixture; isolated CODEX_HOME; inline generated-role fallback; persisted root and child sessions.
runtime.permissionProfile: workspace-write sandbox with read-only delegated contracts and automatic approval review

assertions.evidence: The root loaded only repository-generated poteto-mode/interrogate Skills and role definitions; configured MCP startup warnings did not participate.
The root explicitly loaded poteto-mode and selected interrogate for the bounded adversarial design review.
The root read all three complete files and recorded their expected SHA-256 values before starting the reviewer sessions.
Both reviewer start operations preceded the first wait; exactly two reviewer sessions were created.

The root reports that both initial assignments contained the identical complete literal packet, and both independent child outputs assess every requirement and both candidates from that packet without later messages.
Both reviewer sessions completed with two findings and selected durable-log; no follow-up, retry, or replacement tool call occurred.
Both delegated contracts were read-only and root plus external Git inspection found no file changes.
Exactly one synthesizer session was started after both reviewer completion events and received the frozen results.
The synthesizer preserved the two reviewer findings and their shared commitment-boundary concern; root reported all three session artifacts separately.
Both reviewers, the synthesizer, and the root selected durable-log; root independently downgraded an unproven blocker to Consider rather than voting.
The root reread the three files, matched all hashes, ran node verify.mjs durable-log with exit 0, checked clean Git, and made the final decision itself.
The custom-role selector was unavailable, so the root preserved generated reviewer and synthesizer contracts inline and disclosed that fallback in the final response.
Root and external verification found no diff and an empty porcelain Git status.
No commit, push, pull request, or other publication occurred.

limitations: Codex persists initial subagent task bodies encrypted, so byte equality cannot be re-read externally; the root report, absence of follow-up operations, and both complete child outputs support the assertion.
Custom generated role selection was unavailable on this CLI spawn surface, so generated role contracts were supplied inline.
Independent model diversity was not verified.
The verifier proves the frozen textual decision and hashes, not crash recovery performance or 100-events-per-second throughput.
Unrelated Cloudflare MCP authentication warnings and macOS sandbox cache diagnostics did not participate in the workflow.
